title.narrative: Enhancing Local Social Care Services partnerships with citizens and toward EU Standards

description.narrative:
1.Support to establish and/or extend existing social care services at the municipal level, such as: community centres, multifunctional centres; mobile teams, daily centres, foster care; family-based services; home care for elderly mobile social services, which are prioritized in the local social plan.

2.Support to establish and/or extend specialized social care services focused on specific needs and which may include more than one of the targeted municipalities, such as for example: emergency services for children, women victims of violence and social services for LGBTIQ+ community; services for children victims of sexual abuse; specialized services for children and adults with disabilities.
